profile.summary: Jupiter Life Line Hospitals Limited, a multi-specialty hospital, provides health care services under the Jupiter brand in India. The company offers treatments in the areas of bariatric surgery, breast care center, cardiac surgery, cardiology, chest medicine, dental care, dermatology, endocrinology and diabetes, ENT, gastroenterology, general surgery and minimal access surgery, hematology and BMT,
